intestacyStatutoryLegacy.legislativeReference: Administration of Estates Act 1925 s.46 (as amended by SI 2023/758)
intestacyStatutoryLegacy.notes: Statutory legacy increased from £270,000 to £322,000 on 27 July 2023.

nilRateBand.notes: Frozen at £325,000 since 2009. Extended freeze announced until at least 2028.

residenceNilRateBand.notes: Main residence nil-rate band reached its target of £175,000 in 2020-21.

inheritanceTaxRate.notes: Standard rate of 40% has been in place since 1988. Reduced rate of 36% applies where 10% or more of net estate is left to charity.

cohabitantRights.statute: Inheritance (Provision for Family and Dependants) Act 1975
cohabitantRights.notes: Cohabitants have no automatic entitlement under intestacy rules in England and Wales but may apply under IFPA 1975 as a 'maintained person' or, since 1995, as a person who lived with the deceased as spouse for at least two years.

ifpa1975Eligible.notes: Surviving spouse of the deceased, married for 32 years.
Adult daughter, financially independent but included for completeness.
Long-term carer who was maintained by the deceased immediately before death.

legislativeChanges.description: Proposed reform to extend automatic inheritance rights to cohabiting partners who have lived together for two or more years.
legislativeChanges.notes: Law Commission recommended reform in 2011; successive governments have not legislated. Fresh consultation launched in 2026.

legislativeChanges.description: Finance Act 2026 freezing the nil-rate band at £325,000 until April 2030.
legislativeChanges.notes: Continuation of the freeze first introduced in 2009.

x-inherit-practitionerNotes.value: This fixture demonstrates a typical mid-value English estate with IHT exposure and a potential IFPA 1975 claim from a maintained person.
